title: Dasein and situated dasein stay distinct
body: Capitalized Dasein names the selected coherent whole while situated dasein names a finite actual bearer within it; neither is an inventory of the other.

title: Finity is determinate manifestation
body: Finity names determinate manifestation in a declared frame, not finite cardinality and not numeric one.

title: Value, word, process, operator, and boundary are different types
body: A value, its written sign, a generating process, an operator, and a boundary object may be related without being identical.

title: Higher descriptions may add explanatory value without blocking reduction
body: A macro description can remain explanatorily useful when a lower-level reduction exists, provided it earns prediction, intervention, compression, or portability after costs.

title: Quantum state and actual record are different types
body: A probability-bearing quantum state and a definite measurement record should not be conflated, even though the distinction alone does not solve measurement.

title: Commitment and received consequence need separate receipts
body: An actor's stated plan or self-report is not the independently received consequence of the act.

title: Possibility acts only through actual carriers
body: Represented D5 possibilities influence action only through actual D4 models, bodies, utterances, instruments, memories or institutions.

title: The Soul Loop preserves execution and outcome gaps
body: A useful reflective loop keeps perception, modelling, commitment, authorization, execution, observation and revision distinguishable.

title: Egregoreotype is an observable coordination hypothesis
body: An egregoreotype may be tested as persistent distributed coordination with shared trace, incentive coupling, boundary maintenance and intervention-sensitive added value, without asserting personhood.

title: Language may deepen coordination
body: Shared language may add coordination depth beyond thin exchange signals, but it transfers no truth, consent or common worldview by itself.

title: Worldview competition can be one cause of conflict
body: Conflicting coordination patterns may contribute to war alongside security, capacity, geography, finance, trauma and revenge.

title: Rosetta axes must not collapse
body: Trophic role, replicator layer, reasoning function, operator alias and mating or kinship structure are separate axes unless a specific bridge is earned.

title: Functions are trainable and mobile
body: Rosetta work functions are movable practices and never hereditary classes, ranks of human worth or sovereign identities.

title: Operational agency is usable under metaphysical nonclosure
body: Agents can be assessed by represented options, means, authorization, action and correction while consciousness, ultimate freedom and post-death survival remain open.

title: Teleology needs two clocks and all bearers
body: A teleological proposal must expose short-horizon enactment and long-horizon option effects for every affected bearer rather than hiding delayed cost in one score.

title: Reciprocal public reason has a conditional bridge
body: Inside a voluntarily undertaken reciprocal public-reason practice, arbitrary denial of visibility, contest, correction or feasible Exit defeats the declared reciprocity.

title: Guardianship is separate from reciprocity
body: Care for dependent, absent, nonhuman, ecological and future bearers is a separately chosen, bounded and reviewable extension, not proof borrowed from co-agency.

title: Moral objectivity must be typed
body: Definition stability, procedural reproducibility, empirical adequacy and stance-independent moral realism are different claims and must not inherit one another's warrant.

title: Selected is not solved
body: A philosophical question earns a result only after native recovery, premise preservation, serious controls, unfired kills and independent native-domain review.

title: The means is the message
body: How an act is carried already shapes the relation it claims to serve; carriers, costs, consent, authority, reversibility and externalities are part of the claim.

title: The ends are the limits
body: Every desired end remains bounded for each affected bearer and responsible horizon; no aggregate end erases a failed row.

title: G7 closure is vocabulary-scoped
body: Four bearer-oriented transfers plus three read-only frames close the selected G7 vocabulary and nothing larger.
